name: com.velvet.core
description: React-style declarative UI framework for Unity UI Toolkit. Provides virtual DOM, reconciliation engine, hooks, and component model.

samples.description: A scene to open and press Play on. Hosts a panel on a UIDocument, attaches the bundled utility stylesheet from code, and mounts a two-route app over a store: keyed list, local state, an effect, hover variants and an enter/exit transition.
